lines.c: 你好！想買啲咩？
lines.j: nei5 hou2! soeng2 maai5 di1 me1?
lines.e: Hello! What would you like to buy?

lines.c: 你好！我想買生果。
lines.j: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 maai5 saang1 gwo2.
lines.e: Hi! I'd like to buy some fruit.
optsJ: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 maai5 saang1 gwo2.

lines.c: 好呀，慢慢睇。呢啲生果好新鮮。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, maan6 maan6 tai2. ni1 di1 saang1 gwo2 hou2 san1 sin1.
lines.e: Sure, take your time. This fruit is very fresh.

lines.c: 幾錢呀？
lines.j: gei2 cin2 aa3?
lines.e: How much is it?

lines.c: 一個五蚊，十個四十蚊。
lines.j: jat1 go3 ng5 man1, sap6 go3 sei3 sap6 man1.
lines.e: Five dollars each, ten for forty dollars.

lines.c: 唔好意思,我唔係好明,可唔可以講慢啲？
lines.j: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1?
lines.e: Sorry, I didn't quite understand — could you speak more slowly?
opts: 唔好意思,我唔係好明,可唔可以講慢啲？
optsJ: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1?

lines.c: 當然！一個五蚊。你要幾多個？
lines.j: dong1 jin4! jat1 go3 ng5 man1. nei5 jiu3 gei2 do1 go3?
lines.e: Of course! Five dollars each. How many do you want?

lines.c: 我要三個。
lines.j: ngo5 jiu3 saam1 go3.
lines.e: I'll take three.

lines.c: 好,三個係十五蚊。
lines.j: hou2, saam1 go3 hai6 sap6 ng5 man1.
lines.e: Sure, three is fifteen dollars.

lines.c: 明白喇,多謝！
lines.j: ming4 baak6 laa3, do1 ze6!
lines.e: Got it, thank you!

lines.c: 喂！你食咗飯未呀？
lines.j: wai3! nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Hey! Have you eaten yet?

lines.c: 未呀，仲未食。點解問呢？
lines.j: mei6 aa3, zung6 mei6 sik6. dim2 gaai2 man6 ne1?
lines.e: Not yet, still haven't eaten. Why do you ask?

lines.c: 不如而家一齊去飲茶啦！你得唔得閒呀？
lines.j: bat1 jyu4 ji4 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1! nei5 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3?
lines.e: Then let's go for yum cha now! Are you free?

lines.c: 而家唔得喎，我要返工。星期六呢？
lines.j: ji4 gaa1 m4 dak1 wo3, ngo5 jiu3 faan1 gung1. sing1 kei4 luk6 ne1?
lines.e: Now's no good — I have to work. What about Saturday?

lines.c: 星期六得呀！你去過嗰間茶樓未呀？
lines.j: sing1 kei4 luk6 dak1 aa3! nei5 heoi3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caa4 lau4 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Saturday works! Have you been to that teahouse before?

lines.c: 未去過喎。我哋幾時見面？
lines.j: mei6 heoi3 gwo3 wo3. ngo5 dei6 gei2 si4 gin3 min6?
lines.e: I haven't. When shall we meet?

lines.c: 朝早十點得唔得呀？
lines.j: ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
lines.e: Is 10 in the morning okay?

lines.c: 好呀！邊個一齊去呀？
lines.j: hou2 aa3! bin1 go3 jat1 cai4 heoi3 aa3?
lines.e: Great! Who else is coming?

lines.c: 得我哋兩個咋。我訂咗張枱喇。
lines.j: dak1 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zaa3. ngo5 deng6 zo2 zoeng1 toi2 laa3.
lines.e: Just the two of us. I've booked a table.

lines.c: 明白喇！星期六朝早見啦！
lines.j: ming4 baak6 laa3! sing1 kei4 luk6 ziu1 zou2 gin3 laa1!
lines.e: Got it! See you Saturday morning!

lines.c: 你好！我想買啲嘢煮飯。
lines.j: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 je5 zyu2 faan6.
lines.e: Hi! I want to buy some things to cook a meal.

lines.c: 好呀！今日啲魚同蝦好新鮮。
lines.j: hou2 aa3! gam1 jat6 di1 jyu2 tung4 haa1 hou2 san1 sin1.
lines.e: Sure! Today's fish and prawns are very fresh.

lines.c: 咁我要一條魚同啲蝦。有冇牛肉？
lines.j: gam2 ngo5 jiu3 jat1 tiu4 jyu2 tung4 di1 haa1. jau5 mou5 ngau4 juk6?
lines.e: Then I'll have a fish and some prawns. Any beef?

lines.c: 有，仲有雞同豬肉。
lines.j: jau5, zung6 jau5 gai1 tung4 zyu1 juk6.
lines.e: Yes, also chicken and pork.

lines.c: 唔該畀啲牛肉。仲想買啲菜同生果。
lines.j: m4 goi1 bei2 di1 ngau4 juk6. zung6 soeng2 maai5 di1 coi3 tung4 saang1 gwo2.
lines.e: Beef please. I also want some vegetables and fruit.

lines.c: 菜心好靚，蘋果同橙都好甜。
lines.j: coi3 sam1 hou2 leng3, ping4 gwo2 tung4 caang2 dou1 hou2 tim4.
lines.e: The choy sum is nice, and the apples and oranges are sweet.

lines.c: 全部都要！仲有冇凍嘅飲品？
lines.j: cyun4 bou6 dou1 jiu3! zung6 jau5 mou5 dung3 ge3 jam2 ban2?
lines.e: I'll take it all! Any cold drinks?

lines.c: 有汽水、果汁同啤酒。
lines.j: jau5 hei3 seoi2, gwo2 zap1 tung4 be1 zau2.
lines.e: There's soft drinks, juice and beer.

lines.c: 咁要汽水同啤酒啦。一共幾錢呀？
lines.j: gam2 jiu3 hei3 seoi2 tung4 be1 zau2 laa1. jat1 gung6 gei2 cin2 aa3?
lines.e: Then soft drinks and beer, please. How much in total?

lines.c: 一共一百五十蚊。
lines.j: jat1 gung6 jat1 baak3 ng5 sap6 man1.
lines.e: 150 dollars in total.

lines.c: 你好！呢個係餐牌，想落單未呀？
lines.j: nei5 hou2! ni1 go3 hai6 caan1 paai4, soeng2 lok6 daan1 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Hello! Here's the menu — ready to order?

lines.c: 我好餓，想要啲點心。
lines.j: ngo5 hou2 ngo6, soeng2 jiu3 di1 dim2 sam1.
lines.e: I'm very hungry — I'd like some dim sum.

lines.c: 飲咩呀？凍茶定熱茶？
lines.j: jam2 me1 aa3? dung3 caa4 ding6 jit6 caa4?
lines.e: What to drink? Cold tea or hot tea?

lines.c: 熱茶啦，唔該。有冇魚同蔬菜？
lines.j: jit6 caa4 laa1, m4 goi1. jau5 mou5 jyu2 tung4 so1 coi3?
lines.e: Hot tea please. Do you have fish and vegetables?

lines.c: 有呀，我哋啲魚係蒸嘅，好新鮮。
lines.j: jau5 aa3, ngo5 dei6 di1 jyu2 hai6 zing1 ge3, hou2 san1 sin1.
lines.e: Yes — our fish is steamed, very fresh.

lines.c: 好呀，要一條蒸魚同啲蔬菜。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, jiu3 jat1 tiu4 zing1 jyu2 tung4 di1 so1 coi3.
lines.e: Great, I'll have a steamed fish and some vegetables.

lines.c: 食得飽未呀？
lines.j: sik6 dak1 baau2 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Are you full?

lines.c: 好飽喇，好好食！唔該埋單。
lines.j: hou2 baau2 laa3, hou2 hou2 sik6! m4 goi1 maai4 daan1.
lines.e: Very full — delicious! Bill please.

lines.c: 一共二百蚊，要唔要收據呀？
lines.j: jat1 gung6 ji6 baak3 man1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 sau1 geoi3 aa3?
lines.e: Two hundred dollars in total — would you like a receipt?

lines.c: 要呀，多謝！下次我去超市買食材，自己煮畀你食。
lines.j: jiu3 aa3, do1 ze6! haa6 ci3 ngo5 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 sik6 coi4, zi6 gei2 zyu2 bei2 nei5 sik6.
lines.e: Yes please, thanks! Next time I'll go to the supermarket, buy ingredients, and cook for you myself.

lines.c: 你想買邊件外套？
lines.j: nei5 soeng2 maai5 bin1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3?
lines.e: Which coat do you want to buy?

lines.c: 我鍾意呢件，不過有啲貴。
lines.j: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ni1 gin6, bat1 gwo3 jau5 di1 gwai3.
lines.e: I like this one, but it's a bit expensive.

lines.c: 嗰件平啲，而且仲新啲。
lines.j: go2 gin6 peng4 di1, ji4 ce2 zung6 san1 di1.
lines.e: That one's cheaper, and newer too.

lines.c: 但係呢件靚過嗰件。
lines.j: daan6 hai6 ni1 gin6 leng3 gwo3 go2 gin6.
lines.e: But this one is nicer than that one.

lines.c: 你可以兩件都試下。
lines.j: nei5 ho2 ji5 loeng5 gin6 dou1 si3 haa5.
lines.e: You can try both on.

lines.c: 好主意！我想要最舒服嗰件。
lines.j: hou2 zyu2 ji3! ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 zeoi3 syu1 fuk6 go2 gin6.
lines.e: Good idea! I want the most comfortable one.

lines.c: 呢件大啲，著得舒服啲。
lines.j: ni1 gin6 daai6 di1, zoek3 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
lines.e: This one is bigger, more comfortable to wear.

lines.c: 咁我應該買呢件喇。
lines.j: gam2 ngo5 jing1 goi1 maai5 ni1 gin6 laa3.
lines.e: Then I should buy this one.

lines.c: 啱呀，呢件同你條褲好襯。
lines.j: ngaam1 aa3, ni1 gin6 tung4 nei5 tiu4 fu3 hou2 can3.
lines.e: Right, it goes well with your trousers.

lines.c: 決定喇，我要呢件！
lines.j: kyut3 ding6 laa3, ngo5 jiu3 ni1 gin6!
lines.e: Decided — I'll take this one!

lines.c: 今日天氣真係好好！
lines.j: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2!
lines.e: The weather is really lovely today!

lines.c: 係呀，太陽好猛，又唔熱。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, taai3 joeng4 hou2 maang5, jau6 m4 jit6.
lines.e: Yes — the sun is strong, but it's not hot.

lines.c: 嗰隻狗好可愛呀！係你養㗎？
lines.j: go2 zek3 gau2 hou2 ho2 oi3 aa3! hai6 nei5 joeng5 gaa3?
lines.e: That dog is so cute! Is it yours?

lines.c: 係呀，佢係我嘅寵物。我仲養咗一隻貓。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 cung2 mat6. ngo5 zung6 joeng5 zo2 jat1 zek3 maau1.
lines.e: Yes, he's my pet. I also have a cat.

lines.c: 你隻貓係咩色㗎？
lines.j: nei5 zek3 maau1 hai6 me1 sik1 gaa3?
lines.e: What colour is your cat?

lines.c: 白色同黑色嘅。佢隻眼係藍色，好靚。
lines.j: baak6 sik1 tung4 hak1 sik1 ge3. keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 hai6 laam4 sik1, hou2 leng3.
lines.e: Black and white. Its eyes are blue — very pretty.

lines.c: 哇，聽日好似會落雨喎。
lines.j: waa3, ting1 jat6 hou2 ci5 wui5 lok6 jyu5 wo3.
lines.e: Wow. Looks like it'll rain tomorrow, though.

lines.c: 係呀，仲話有颱風。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, zung6 waa6 jau5 toi4 fung1.
lines.e: Yes, they say there's a typhoon coming too.

lines.c: 咁今日真係要好好享受啲太陽喇。
lines.j: gam2 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 hoeng2 sau6 di1 taai3 joeng4 laa3.
lines.e: Then we really should enjoy the sun today.

lines.c: 啱呀！我哋帶隻狗去行下啦。
lines.j: ngaam1 aa3! ngo5 dei6 daai3 zek3 gau2 heoi3 haang4 haa5 laa1.
lines.e: Right! Let's take the dog for a walk.

lines.c: 你今日好似唔開心喎，做咩呀？
lines.j: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 hoi1 sam1 wo3, zou6 me1 aa3?
lines.e: You seem unhappy today — what's wrong?

lines.c: 我有啲擔心，我媽媽病咗。
lines.j: ngo5 jau5 di1 daam1 sam1, ngo5 maa4 maa1 beng6 zo2.
lines.e: I'm a bit worried — my mum is sick.

lines.c: 吓？佢邊度唔舒服呀？
lines.j: haa2? keoi5 bin1 dou6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3?
lines.e: Oh? Where doesn't she feel well?

lines.c: 佢個頭好痛，仲有啲肚痛。
lines.j: keoi5 go3 tau4 hou2 tung3, zung6 jau5 di1 tou5 tung3.
lines.e: Her head really hurts, and her stomach aches a bit too.

lines.c: 唉，咁你一定好擔心。你爸爸知唔知呀？
lines.j: aai1, gam2 nei5 jat1 ding6 hou2 daam1 sam1. nei5 baa4 baa1 zi1 m4 zi1 aa3?
lines.e: Aw, you must be so worried. Does your dad know?

lines.c: 知呀，佢同我姐姐而家照顧緊佢。
lines.j: zi1 aa3, keoi5 tung4 ngo5 ze4 ze1 ji4 gaa1 ziu3 gu3 gan2 keoi5.
lines.e: Yes — he and my older sister are looking after her now.

lines.c: 你唔好太緊張，佢會好返嘅。
lines.j: nei5 m4 hou2 taai3 gan2 zoeng1, keoi5 wui5 hou2 faan1 ge3.
lines.e: Don't be too anxious — she'll get better.

lines.c: 多謝你。有你呢個朋友真係好。
lines.j: do1 ze6 nei5. jau5 nei5 ni1 go3 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2.
lines.e: Thank you. I'm lucky to have a friend like you.

lines.c: 應該嘅！得閒一齊去探佢啦。
lines.j: jing1 goi1 ge3! dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 taam3 keoi5 laa1.
lines.e: Of course! When we're free let's visit her together.

lines.c: 好呀，佢一定會好開心。
lines.j: hou2 aa3, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
lines.e: Yes — she'll be really happy.

lines.c: 你準備好未呀？
lines.j: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Are you ready yet?

lines.c: 仲未，我搵唔到件外套。
lines.j: zung6 mei6, ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 gin6 ngoi6 tou3.
lines.e: Not yet, I can't find my coat.

lines.c: 喺梳化上面呀。
lines.j: hai2 so1 faa2 soeng6 min6 aa3.
lines.e: It's on the sofa.

lines.c: 唔喺度喎。我對鞋呢？
lines.j: m4 hai2 dou6 wo3. ngo5 deoi3 haai4 ne1?
lines.e: It's not there. What about my shoes?

lines.c: 鞋喺門口，櫃下面。
lines.j: haai4 hai2 mun4 hau2, gwai6 haa6 min6.
lines.e: The shoes are at the door, under the cabinet.

lines.c: 搵到喇！我條褲喺邊度？
lines.j: wan2 dou2 laa3! ngo5 tiu4 fu3 hai2 bin1 dou6?
lines.e: Found them! Where are my trousers?

lines.c: 喺房入面，張床上面。
lines.j: hai2 fong2 jap6 min6, zoeng1 cong4 soeng6 min6.
lines.e: In the room, on the bed.

lines.c: 多謝！我嘅手錶又喺邊度？
lines.j: do1 ze6! ngo5 ge3 sau2 biu1 jau6 hai2 bin1 dou6?
lines.e: Thanks! And where's my watch?

lines.c: 喺廁所，洗手盆旁邊。
lines.j: hai2 ci3 so2, sai2 sau2 pun4 pong4 bin1.
lines.e: In the bathroom, beside the sink.

lines.c: 終於搵齊喇，可以出門喇！
lines.j: zung1 jyu1 wan2 cai4 laa3, ho2 ji5 ceot1 mun4 laa3!
lines.e: Finally found everything — we can head out!

lines.c: 唔該，請問去呢間酒店點行呀？
lines.j: m4 goi1, cing2 man6 heoi3 ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 dim2 haang4 aa3?
lines.e: Excuse me, how do I get to this hotel?

lines.c: 好近啫。你直行，然後喺前面轉左。
lines.j: hou2 kan5 ze1. nei5 zik6 haang4, jin4 hau6 hai2 cin4 min6 zyun3 zo2.
lines.e: It's very close. Go straight, then turn left up ahead.

lines.c: 行路遠唔遠呀？定係搭的士好啲？
lines.j: haang4 lou6 jyun5 m4 jyun5 aa3? ding6 hai6 daap3 dik1 si2 hou2 di1?
lines.e: Is it far to walk? Or is a taxi better?

lines.c: 唔使啦，行路五分鐘咋。喺後面仲有個地鐵站。
lines.j: m4 sai2 laa1, haang4 lou6 ng5 fan1 zung1 zaa3. hai2 hau6 min6 zung6 jau5 go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6.
lines.e: No need — it's just a five-minute walk. There's also an MTR station behind you.

lines.c: 明白！酒店附近有冇景點呀？
lines.j: ming4 baak6! zau2 dim3 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 ging2 dim2 aa3?
lines.e: Got it! Are there any attractions near the hotel?

lines.c: 有呀，對面有個好出名嘅景點，可以拍照。
lines.j: jau5 aa3, deoi3 min6 jau5 go3 hou2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 ging2 dim2, ho2 ji5 paak3 ziu3.
lines.e: Yes — opposite there's a famous attraction where you can take photos.

lines.c: 好正！要唔要買門票呀？
lines.j: hou2 zeng3! jiu3 m4 jiu3 maai5 mun4 piu3 aa3?
lines.e: Awesome! Do I need to buy a ticket?

lines.c: 要呀，不過而家要排隊，好多人。
lines.j: jiu3 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2, hou2 do1 jan4.
lines.e: Yes, but right now you'd have to queue — lots of people.

lines.c: 咁我聽日先去啦。多謝晒你！
lines.j: gam2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 laa1. do1 ze6 saai3 nei5!
lines.e: Then I'll go tomorrow instead. Thank you so much!

lines.c: 唔使客氣！祝你旅途愉快！
lines.j: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3! zuk1 nei5 leoi5 tou4 jyu4 faai3!
lines.e: You're welcome! Enjoy your trip!

lines.c: 喂，今日開唔開會呀？
lines.j: wai3, gam1 jat6 hoi1 m4 hoi1 wui2 aa3?
lines.e: Hey, is there a meeting today?

lines.c: 開呀，不過我部電腦壞咗。
lines.j: hoi1 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2.
lines.e: Yes, but my computer is broken.

lines.c: 吓？係咪上唔到網呀？
lines.j: haa2? hai6 mai6 soeng5 m4 dou3 mong5 aa3?
lines.e: Oh? Can't get online?

lines.c: 係呀，個訊號好差，WiFi又壞咗。
lines.j: hai6 aa3, go3 seon3 hou6 hou2 caa1, WiFi jau6 waai6 zo2.
lines.e: Yeah, the signal's bad and the WiFi's down too.

lines.c: 你打電話問下老闆啦。
lines.j: nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 man6 haa5 lou5 baan2 laa1.
lines.e: Call and ask the boss.

lines.c: 好啦。講起，今個月出咗糧未呀？
lines.j: hou2 laa1. gong2 hei2, gam1 go3 jyut6 ceot1 zo2 loeng4 mei6 aa3?
lines.e: Okay. By the way, has this month's pay come through yet?

lines.c: 出咗喇，今朝啱啱入咗銀行戶口。
lines.j: ceot1 zo2 laa3, gam1 ziu1 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 zo2 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2.
lines.e: It has — it just went into the bank account this morning.

lines.c: 好彩！我等錢交租。
lines.j: hou2 coi2! ngo5 dang2 cin2 gaau1 zou1.
lines.e: Lucky! I need the money for rent.

lines.c: 你而家返屋企定係放工先去銀行？
lines.j: nei5 ji4 gaa1 faan1 uk1 kei2 ding6 hai6 fong3 gung1 sin1 heoi3 ngan4 hong4?
lines.e: Are you going home now or to the bank after work?

lines.c: 放工先去啦，而家仲要開會添。
lines.j: fong3 gung1 sin1 heoi3 laa1, ji4 gaa1 zung6 jiu3 hoi1 wui2 tim1.
lines.e: After work — I still have the meeting now.

lines.c: 聽日得閒，不如去行山啦！
lines.j: ting1 jat6 dak1 haan4, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1!
lines.e: If you're free tomorrow, let's go hiking!

lines.c: 好呀！我最鍾意行山，又可以做運動。
lines.j: hou2 aa3! ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 haang4 saan1, jau6 ho2 ji5 zou6 wan6 dung6.
lines.e: Yes! I love hiking — it's good exercise too.

lines.c: 啱呀！行完我哋仲可以去游水。
lines.j: ngaam1 aa3! haang4 jyun4 ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 jau4 seoi2.
lines.e: Right! After, we can go swimming too.

lines.c: 哎呀！我跌親，隻腳好痛！
lines.j: aai1 jaa3! ngo5 dit3 can1, zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3!
lines.e: Ow! I fell — my foot really hurts!

lines.c: 吓？你受咗傷呀？仲行唔行得呀？
lines.j: haa2? nei5 sau6 zo2 soeng1 aa3? zung6 haang4 m4 haang4 dak1 aa3?
lines.e: What? Are you injured? Can you still walk?

lines.c: 行唔到呀，好似好嚴重。
lines.j: haang4 m4 dou3 aa3, hou2 ci5 hou2 jim4 zung6.
lines.e: I can't — it seems quite serious.

lines.c: 唔好郁住！我即刻打999叫救護車。
lines.j: m4 hou2 juk1 zyu6! ngo5 zik1 hak1 daa2 gau2 gau2 gau2 giu3 gau3 wu6 ce1.
lines.e: Don't move! I'll call 999 for an ambulance right now.

lines.c: 唔該晒你！好彩有你喺度。
lines.j: m4 goi1 saai3 nei5! hou2 coi2 jau5 nei5 hai2 dou6.
lines.e: Thank you so much! Lucky you're here.

lines.c: 唔使驚，救護車好快到。
lines.j: m4 sai2 geng1, gau3 wu6 ce1 hou2 faai3 dou3.
lines.e: Don't be scared — the ambulance will be here soon.

lines.c: 知喇，多謝你！下次小心啲先得。
lines.j: zi1 laa3, do1 ze6 nei5! haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 sin1 dak1.
lines.e: Okay, thank you! Next time we'd better be more careful.

lines.c: 聽日放假，你想做啲咩？
lines.j: ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3, nei5 soeng2 zou6 di1 me1?
lines.e: Tomorrow's a day off — what do you want to do?

lines.c: 如果天氣好，我哋就去行山。
lines.j: jyu4 gwo2 tin1 hei3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
lines.e: If the weather's good, we'll go hiking.
opts: 如果天氣好，我哋就去行山。
optsJ: jyu4 gwo2 tin1 hei3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 haang4 saan1.

lines.c: 不過聽日可能落雨喎。
lines.j: bat1 gwo3 ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 lok6 jyu5 wo3.
lines.e: But it might rain tomorrow.

lines.c: 咁如果落雨，我哋就去睇戲。
lines.j: gam2 jyu4 gwo2 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
lines.e: Then if it rains, we'll go to a film.
opts: 咁如果落雨，我哋就去睇戲。
optsJ: gam2 jyu4 gwo2 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 tai2 hei3.

lines.c: 好。雖然戲飛貴啲，但係好過喺屋企。
lines.j: hou2. seoi1 jin4 hei3 fei1 gwai3 di1, daan6 hai6 hou2 gwo3 hai2 uk1 kei2.
lines.e: OK. Although film tickets are a bit pricey, it beats staying home.

lines.c: 而且睇完戲，我哋仲可以食飯。
lines.j: ji4 ce2 tai2 jyun4 hei3, ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 sik6 faan6.
lines.e: And after the film, we can also have a meal.
opts: 而且睇完戲，我哋仲可以食飯。
optsJ: ji4 ce2 tai2 jyun4 hei3, ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 sik6 faan6.

lines.c: 因為我好耐冇睇戲，所以好期待。
lines.j: jan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 tai2 hei3, so2 ji5 hou2 kei4 doi6.
lines.e: Because I haven't seen a film in ages, I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.c: 咁就決定喇，聽日見！
lines.j: gam2 zau6 kyut3 ding6 laa3, ting1 jat6 gin3!
lines.e: Then it's decided — see you tomorrow!
optsJ: gam2 zau6 kyut3 ding6 laa3, ting1 jat6 gin3!

lines.c: 今晚不如出去食飯，然後行下街？
lines.j: gam1 maan5 bat1 jyu4 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6, jin4 hau6 haang4 haa5 gaai1?
lines.e: How about going out to eat tonight, then some shopping?

lines.c: 好啊！如果想食好嘢，最好訂枱。
lines.j: hou2 aa3! jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 sik6 hou2 je5, zeoi3 hou2 deng6 toi2.
lines.e: Great! If we want good food, best to book a table.
opts: 好啊！如果想食好嘢，最好訂枱。
optsJ: hou2 aa3! jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 sik6 hou2 je5, zeoi3 hou2 deng6 toi2.

lines.c: 我訂咗喇。不過今晚好多人，可能要等位。
lines.j: ngo5 deng6 zo2 laa3. bat1 gwo3 gam1 maan5 hou2 do1 jan4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 dang2 wai2.
lines.e: I booked. But there are lots of people tonight, we might have to wait.

lines.c: 冇問題。我食素，所以想叫啲唔辣嘅餸。
lines.j: mou5 man6 tai4. ngo5 sik6 sou3, so2 ji5 soeng2 giu3 di1 m4 laat6 ge3 sung3.
lines.e: No problem. I'm vegetarian, so I want to order some non-spicy dishes.
opts: 冇問題。我食素，所以想叫啲唔辣嘅餸。
optsJ: mou5 man6 tai4. ngo5 sik6 sou3, so2 ji5 soeng2 giu3 di1 m4 laat6 ge3 sung3.

lines.c: 好。我哋可以叫侍應介紹下。
lines.j: hou2. ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 giu3 si6 jing3 gaai3 siu6 haa5.
lines.e: OK. We can ask the waiter to recommend something.

lines.c: 食完飯之後，不如去行街買嘢。
lines.j: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 maai5 je5.
lines.e: After we eat, how about going shopping?
opts: 食完飯之後，不如去行街買嘢。
optsJ: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 maai5 je5.
sik6 jyun4 zau6 faan1 uk1 kei2.

lines.c: 好主意！如果見到平嘅，我哋可以講價。
lines.j: hou2 zyu2 ji3! jyu4 gwo2 gin3 dou2 peng4 ge3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gong2 gaa3.
lines.e: Good idea! If we spot cheap ones, we can haggle.

lines.c: 而且好多舖頭特價，可以碌卡或者用八達通。
lines.j: ji4 ce2 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dak6 gaa3, ho2 ji5 luk1 kaat1 waak6 ze2 jung6 baat3 daat6 tung1.
lines.e: And lots of shops are on sale — we can pay by card or use Octopus.
opts: 而且好多舖頭特價，可以碌卡或者用八達通。
optsJ: ji4 ce2 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dak6 gaa3, ho2 ji5 luk1 kaat1 waak6 ze2 jung6 baat3 daat6 tung1.
ngo5 zing6 hai6 jung6 jin6 gam1.

lines.c: 太好喇，咁就今晚見！
lines.j: taai3 hou2 laa3, gam2 zau6 gam1 maan5 gin3!
lines.e: Great, see you tonight then!

lines.c: 好耐冇見！你近排點呀？
lines.j: hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3! nei5 gan6 paai2 dim2 aa3?
lines.e: Long time no see! How have you been?

lines.c: 幾好呀！好掛住你㗎。
lines.j: gei2 hou2 aa3! hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5 gaa3.
lines.e: Pretty good! I really missed you.
optsJ: gei2 hou2 aa3! hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5 gaa3.
dou1 hai6 gam2 soeng5 haa5, nei5 ne1?
hou2 mong4, mou5 si4 gaan3 ceot1 gaai1.

lines.c: 你有冇聯絡阿華？佢上個月病咗。
lines.j: nei5 jau5 mou5 lyun4 lok3 aa3 waa4? keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 beng6 zo2.
lines.e: Have you been in touch with Ah Wah? She was sick last month.

lines.c: 係咩？佢有冇去睇醫生？
lines.j: hai6 me1? keoi5 jau5 mou5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1?
lines.e: Really? Did she go see a doctor?
optsJ: hai6 me1? keoi5 jau5 mou5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1?
keoi5 jiu3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 me1?

lines.c: 去喇。醫生話佢要多啲休息，而且要食藥，一日三次。
lines.j: heoi3 laa3. ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 do1 di1 jau1 sik1, ji4 ce2 jiu3 sik6 joek6, jat1 jat6 saam1 ci3.
lines.e: She did. The doctor said she needs more rest, and also medicine, three times a day.

lines.c: 雖然佢有啲懶，但係希望佢快啲好返。
lines.j: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 jau5 di1 laan5, daan6 hai6 hei1 mong6 keoi5 faai3 di1 hou2 faan1.
lines.e: Although she is a bit lazy, I hope she gets better soon.
opts: 雖然佢有啲懶，但係希望佢快啲好返。
optsJ: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 jau5 di1 laan5, daan6 hai6 hei1 mong6 keoi5 faai3 di1 hou2 faan1.
keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3, jat1 ding6 faai3 hou2.

lines.c: 哈！係。佢係咁㗎，不過佢好善良，對朋友好好。
lines.j: haa1! hai6. keoi5 hai6 gam2 gaa3, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 hou2 sin6 loeng4, deoi3 pang4 jau5 hou2 hou2.
lines.e: Ha! True. She is like that, but she is very kind — great to her friends.

lines.c: 因為我好掛住佢，不如計劃下去探佢？
lines.j: jan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5, bat1 jyu4 gai3 waak6 haa5 heoi3 taam3 keoi5?
lines.e: Because I really miss her, how about we plan to go visit her?
opts: 因為我好掛住佢，不如計劃下去探佢？
optsJ: jan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5, bat1 jyu4 gai3 waak6 haa5 heoi3 taam3 keoi5?
hou2 aa3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3.
dang2 keoi5 hou2 faan1 sin1 heoi3 laa1.

lines.c: 好主意！如果佢好返，我哋仲可以一齊去敘舊。
lines.j: hou2 zyu2 ji3! jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 hou2 faan1, ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 zeoi6 gau6.
lines.e: Great idea! If she gets better, we can all catch up together.

lines.c: 好呀！記住保持聯絡，唔好再爽約㗎。
lines.j: hou2 aa3! gei3 zyu6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3, m4 hou2 zoi3 song2 joek3 gaa3.
lines.e: Great! Remember to stay in touch — no cancelling again.
opts: 好呀！記住保持聯絡，唔好再爽約㗎。
optsJ: hou2 aa3! gei3 zyu6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3, m4 hou2 zoi3 song2 joek3 gaa3.
hou2, haa6 ci3 zou2 di1 gai3 waak6.
